descriptions.en: Testing before treatment, completing ACT doses, and preventing mosquito bites.
descriptions.yo: Àyẹ̀wò kí o tó lo oògùn, píparí oògùn ibà, àti dídènà ìjẹ ẹ̀fọn.
descriptions.pcm: Make you test before you take drug, finish your malaria medicine, and block mosquito.

descriptions.en: Checking blood pressure regularly, daily medicines, and salt reduction.
descriptions.yo: Ṣíṣàyẹ̀wò ìfúnpá déédéé, oògùn ojoojúmọ́, àti dídín iyọ̀ kù.
descriptions.pcm: How to dey check BP every time, take your everyday medicine, and reduce salt.

descriptions.en: Mixing ORS sachets safely, zinc guidance, and feeding a child with diarrhoea.
descriptions.yo: Pípò omi iyọ̀ ORS lọ́nà tó tọ́, oògùn zinc, àti fífún ọmọ lóúnjẹ.
descriptions.pcm: How to mix ORS water well, use zinc tablet, and still feed pikin wey dey purge.

descriptions.en: Antenatal visits, danger signs that need immediate hospital care, and safe habits.
descriptions.yo: Lílọ sí ilé ìwòsàn aláboyún, àmì ewu kíákíá, àti ìlera oyún.
descriptions.pcm: Antenatal clinic checkups, danger signs wey need hospital sharp-sharp, and healthy food.

descriptions.en: Checking NAFDAC numbers, avoiding leftover antibiotics, and storing medicines safely.
descriptions.yo: Yíyẹ nọ́ńbà NAFDAC wò, píparí oògùn, àti títọ́jú oògùn pamọ́.
descriptions.pcm: Check NAFDAC number and expiry date, no share leftover antibiotics, and keep drugs safe.
